messages:
Maya Nguyen: quick idea — run a 2-week mini feedback lab on ~2% of newly onboarded accounts. lightweight 1-question in-app micro-survey, push a CRM flag, route responses to owners. low-risk, fast signal. thoughts?

Liam Patel: love it. key asks: auto-route to owner, 1x reminder after 48h only, and a toggle/flag so we can turn it off fast if noisy. :+1:

Ash Rivera: doable. plan would be frontend -> webhook -> cs-events queue -> playbook-runner. need a minimal event schema and a sample playbook rule.

Maya Nguyen: schema sketch: `{"account_id":"str","owner_id":"str","feedback":"int","comment":"str?","event_id":"str"}`. event_id for dedupe. playbook idea below.

Jo Chen: quick product question — do we want to fold this into healthscore or treat as an independent signal? my vote: add as a short-lived positive/negative weight so we can measure impact without long-term churn effects. +eyes:

Ash Rivera: sample playbook rule (staging draft):
```yaml
id: fb-mini-lab-v1
description: lightweight micro-feedback routing for onboarding lab
trigger:
  type: event
  event_name: onboarding_micro_feedback
  sample_rate: 0.02  # 2%
conditions: []
actions:
  - set_crm_field:
      field: micro_feedback_flag
      value: true
  - route_to_owner:
      owner_field: owner_id
  - schedule_followup:
      delay: 48h
      message: "Quick follow-up: saw your feedback, can we help?"
  - emit_metric: onboarding.micro_feedback.received
meta:
  feature_flag: mini_feedback_lab_v1
  dedupe_key: event_id
```

Liam Patel: that looks sane. confirm feature flag exists and we gate via `mini_feedback_lab_v1`. also add a kill-switch in playbook-runner so SRE/CS can disable global. :thumbsup:

Playbook Bot: playbook-runner: draft rule created in staging (id=fb-mini-lab-v1, env=staging).

Sam Ortiz: ops note — please ensure `event_id` dedupe and idempotency. if we get duplicates we will spike owner queues. also add a small rate limiter per-owner.

Jo Chen: for healthscore, proposal: if feedback >=4 => +5 weight for 7d; if feedback <=2 => -3 weight for 7d. i'll open a PR to scoring map and add an experiment tag.

Ash Rivera: i'll wire the webhook and add a small consumer to ensure idempotency and per-owner rate cap. will share the consumer logs and a sanity check script.

Maya Nguyen: perfect. rollout plan: 1) create staging rule (done), 2) feature-flagged canary to 2% in prod, 3) monitor owner queue size + feedback distribution for 48h, 4) decide expand or pull. liam — can you draft an ops/rollout doc and acceptance criteria?

Liam Patel: on it. i'll draft in the cs-ops doc and include acceptance checks: owner queue < threshold, <5% negative feedback spike, no more than 3 duplicate events per 1000. assigning to @Liam Patel.

Maya Nguyen: thanks all. quick sync in #cs-ops tomorrow 10:00am to sign off? :sparkles:

Ash Rivera: yep. i'll post the staging debug commands: `curl -X POST https://staging-events.internal/onboarding_micro_feedback -d @sample.json`

Jo Chen: adding experiment tracking tag `mini_feedback_lab_v1` to telemetry so we can slice analytics.

Playbook Bot: playbook-runner: scheduled deploy to staging window tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

Sam Ortiz: also adding a short runbook snippet about reverting the rule and clearing the flag if hit by accident.

Maya Nguyen: great — thanks team. short thread, big signal.
